commands: kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop | grep -v Running; kubectl get events -n astronomy-shop --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -15
sleep 30; kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get deploy payment -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -A30 "containers:"
kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get deploy payment -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -A30 "containers:"

kubectl get cm -n astronomy-shop | grep -i flag; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -B2 -A8 '"defaultVariant"' | grep -E 'defaultVariant|^\s+"[a-zA-Z]+": \{'; kubectl logs -n astronomy-shop deploy/payment --tail=15; kubectl logs -n astronomy-shop deploy/product-catalog --tail=5

cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o json | python3 -I -c '
import json,sys
cm=json.load(sys.stdin)
k=list(cm["data"])[0]
d=json.loads(cm["data"][k])
d["flags"]["paymentFailure"]["defaultVariant"]="off"
cm["data"][k]=json.dumps(d,indent=2)
json.dump({"data":cm["data"]},open("/tmp/patch.json","w"))'
kubectl patch cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop --type merge --patch-file /tmp/patch.json
kubectl rollout restart deploy/flagd deploy/payment -n astronomy-shop; kubectl rollout status deploy/flagd -n astronomy-shop; kubectl rollout status deploy/payment -n astronomy-shop
cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml > cm.yaml; grep -n -A12 '"paymentFailure"' cm.yaml | grep -n defaultVariant
cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -n -A14 '"paymentFailure"'

cd /tmp; sed -i '100s/"100%"/"off"/' cm.yaml; kubectl apply -f cm.yaml -n astronomy-shop && kubectl rollout restart deploy/flagd deploy/payment -n astronomy-shop && kubectl rollout status deploy/flagd -n astronomy-shop && kubectl rollout status deploy/payment -n astronomy-shop; kubectl logs -n astronomy-shop deploy/payment --tail=5
agent.summary:
Payment failures were caused by a feature flag, and I've turned it off. Payment now logs a successful charge, but I only checked the last few log lines. I didn't run a full checkout.

**Root cause:** In the `flagd-config` ConfigMap, the `paymentFailure` flag had `defaultVariant: "100%"`. That made every payment charge fail with "Invalid token". The other pods were running normally.

**Fix:** I set `paymentFailure` to `"off"` in `flagd-config`, then restarted `flagd` and `payment` so they pick up the change. Both rollouts completed.

One side effect: the first `kubectl apply` warned that the ConfigMap had no `last-applied-configuration` annotation. It patched the annotation in automatically, so nothing else about the ConfigMap changed.
